mapper.sql: n.notification_id, n.recipient_user_id, n.notification_type, n.title, n.body, n.link_url, n.related_entity, n.related_id, n.read_yn, n.read_at, n.delete_yn, n.created_by, n.created_ip, n.created_at, n.updated_by, n.updated_ip, n.updated_at, u.login_id AS recipient_login_id
FROM tb_notification n LEFT JOIN v_user_login u ON u.user_id = n.recipient_user_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_notification WHERE recipient_user_id = #{recipientUserId} AND read_yn = 'N' AND delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_notification ( notification_id, recipient_user_id, notification_type, title, body, link_url, related_entity, related_id, read_yn, read_at, delete_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{notificationId}, #{recipientUserId}, #{notificationType}, #{title}, #{body}, #{linkUrl}, #{relatedEntity}, #{relatedId}, 'N', NULL, 'N', #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, NOW(), #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_notification SET read_yn = 'Y', read_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE notification_id = #{notificationId} AND recipient_user_id = #{recipientUserId} AND read_yn = 'N' AND delete_yn = 'N'
